test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The Begumpuri mosque, built during the reign of ______, was the main mosque of Jahanpanah, his new capital in Delhi.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Muhammad Tughluq**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Muhammad Tughluq **had** the Begumpuri mosque** constructed as the primary mosque for Jahanpanah,** the "Sanctuary of the World," his new city in Delhi.**
 
• One of the biggest mosques in the city is called Begampuri Masjid, and it is situated close to Aurobindo Ashram on Sri Aurobindo road in Begampur, close to Delhi.
 
• **Khan-i-Jahan, the son of Muqbal Khan,** the **Prime Minister of Firuz Shah, constructed it in the 12th century.**
 
• **Muhammad bin Tughlaq (1325–51), the Delhi Sultan, founded the fourth mediaeval city of Delhi in the years 1326-1327. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• From February 1325 until his death,** Muhammad ibn Tughlaq **served as the Delhi Sultanate's eighteenth ruler.
 
• He was Ghiyath al-Din Tughluq's (the Tughlaq dynasty's founder) eldest son.
 
• **Ghiyas-ud-din Tughlaq**, who ruled the** Sultanate of Delhi from 1320 to 1325, was the founder of the Tughluq dynasty in India.**
 
• **Tughluqabad was the city he founded.**
 
• The ninth ruler of Delhi's Mamluk dynasty was **Ghiyas ud din Balban.**
 
• The Ghurid monarch Muhammad Ghori's general was **Qutb ud-Din Aibak. **
